_comment: Rotation dictionary: the single source of truth mapping a trick name to the three rotations the model predicts (plan section 4). Keys must also appear in data/flatground_allowlist.csv; human and upstream spellings live there as aliases, not here. Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are skipped by the loader.
_sign_convention: Signed integers in the STANCE-NORMALIZED frame (plan section 7). flip: +kickflip / -heelflip, one unit = 360 deg. board_spin: +backside / -frontside, one unit = 180 deg. body_spin: +backside / -frontside, one unit = 180 deg. Magnitudes are counts, clamped to 0..3 by the quantizer.
_note: backside is positive because that is what the ingested data uses: SkateAI's treflip clips carry board_rotation_type='backside' with number 2, and tre_flip below is board_spin=2. The sign row of plan section 4 read the other way round; that was a typo, corrected in v0.3.1.

fs_bigspin_kickflip.note: The stance mirror of bs_bigspin_kickflip (bigflip). No ingested dataset publishes this trick; it exists so mirror augmentation has a label to land on, making the mirror map a bijection.

fs_biggerspin_heelflip.note: The stance mirror of bs_biggerspin_kickflip (biggerflip). Present so the mirror map is total; no ingested dataset publishes it.

bs_180_double_heelflip.note: The stance mirror of fs_180_double_kickflip. Present so the mirror map is total; no ingested dataset publishes it.

fs_180_double_heelflip.note: The stance mirror of bs_180_double_kickflip. Present so the mirror map is total; no ingested dataset publishes it.

fs_360_double_flip.note: The stance mirror of tre_double_flip. Present so the mirror map is total; no ingested dataset publishes it.

varial_double_heelflip.note: The stance mirror of hard_double_flip: a double heelflip with a backside 180 shuvit, named by analogy with varial_kickflip. Present so the mirror map is total; no ingested dataset publishes it.

half_cab.note: A fakie backside 180. Its rotation triple is identical to bs_180, so the jargon name is recovered by combining the stance column with the rotation-derived label, exactly as plan section 3 intends. Deliberately not a separate rotation target.

full_cab.note: A fakie backside 360: same rotation triple as bs_360, recovered from (stance='fakie', label='bs_360'). Deliberately not a separate rotation target.

impossible.note: The board wraps vertically around the front foot, rotating about an axis the 3-axis (flip/board/body) model does not have. Allowlisted as flatground but not representable, and absent from every ingested dataset. Ingesting an 'impossible' clip fails loudly rather than silently mislabelling it.

none.note: Absence of a trick rather than a trick. Its natural triple (0,0,0) is already taken by ollie, so a rotation-only label cannot separate them; a separate no-trick gate would be needed. Absent from every ingested dataset.
